facts.fact: Ghana's National Communications Authority and Burkina Faso's ARCEP finalised a bilateral frequency coordination agreement on cross-border interference at a meeting in the week before 21 August 2025.
Ghana signed a free roaming agreement with Cote d'Ivoire in February 2024, letting citizens of both countries use mobile services without international roaming charges.
Ghana's NCA and Togo's regulatory authority agreed in November 2023 to establish bilateral roaming services between the two countries.
A free roaming initiative between Benin and Ghana took effect on 1 July 2024, per the article.
A free roaming agreement involving Ghana, Togo and Benin was launched in October 2024, per the article.
